author: Spread
name: Arc gauge
description: A big number in a 270° gradient arc. Set the scale where you use it: =VIZ("arc", A1, "Engine °C", 0, 150)
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 190"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.val{fill:none;stroke:url(#ag);stroke-width:9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:calc((1 - var(--v)) * 100)}.halo{fill:none;stroke:url(#ag);stroke-width:16;opacity:.35;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:calc((1 - var(--v)) * 100)}.big{font-size:58px;fill:url(#tg)}</style><defs><linearGradient id="ag" x1="0" y1="1" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#5b2cff"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="#e0245e"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ff4d2e"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="tg" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ff5470"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ff3b30"/></linearGradient><filter id="ab" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5"/></filter></defs>
<path class="trk" d="M46.26 151.74A76 76 0 1 1 153.74 151.74" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" pathLength="100"/><path class="halo" d="M46.26 151.74A76 76 0 1 1 153.74 151.74" pathLength="100" filter="url(#ab)"/><path class="val" d="M46.26 151.74A76 76 0 1 1 153.74 151.74" pathLength="100"/>
<text x="100" y="118" text-anchor="middle" class="num big">{{value}}</text><text x="100" y="168" text-anchor="middle" class="cap" style="font-size:11px">{{label}}</text></svg>
